places.name: Chapel to the Hospital of St John & St Elizabeth
places.accessNotes: Public access is limited and may require a tour, appointment or attendance at a service or event. Check the official source before making a special journey.
places.hook: A Victorian hospital chapel was moved across London piece by piece and rebuilt inside today’s St John’s Wood complex.
places.description: George Goldie designed this richly detailed Gothic Revival hospital chapel in 1862–63. Originally built in Great Ormond Street, it was dismantled and reconstructed in St John’s Wood in 1898, preserving stained glass, carved fittings and a rare link to Victorian Catholic healthcare.
places.descriptionIt: George Goldie progettò questa cappella ospedaliera neogotica nel 1862–63. Costruita originariamente a Great Ormond Street, fu smontata e ricostruita a St John’s Wood nel 1898, conservando vetrate, arredi scolpiti e un raro legame con l’assistenza cattolica vittoriana.
places.hookIt: Una cappella ospedaliera vittoriana fu trasferita attraverso Londra pezzo per pezzo e ricostruita nell’attuale complesso di St John’s Wood.
places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso pubblico è limitato e può richiedere una visita guidata, un appuntamento o la partecipazione a una funzione o a un evento. Controlla la fonte ufficiale prima di organizzare la visita.

places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Welsh-language hymns and preaching sustain a living piece of Wales in the middle of Fitzrovia.
places.description: The Welsh Church of Central London has served Welsh-speaking Nonconformists in the capital since the eighteenth century and occupies a purpose-built chapel in Eastcastle Street. Worship, preaching, music and social events continue primarily in Welsh, sustaining a distinctive cultural home in Fitzrovia.
places.descriptionIt: La Welsh Church of Central London serve i nonconformisti di lingua gallese nella capitale dal Settecento e occupa una cappella appositamente costruita in Eastcastle Street. Culto, predicazione, musica ed eventi soprattutto in gallese mantengono una casa culturale distinta a Fitzrovia.
places.hookIt: Inni e predicazione in gallese mantengono vivo un frammento del Galles nel cuore di Fitzrovia.

places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Butterfield’s jewel-box church wraps worshippers in Victorian colour, pattern, marble and painted vaults.
places.description: All Saints Margaret Street is William Butterfield’s 1850s masterpiece of Victorian High Gothic and polychromatic design. Its compact interior is saturated with patterned brick, tile, marble, painted ceilings and later murals, creating one of central London’s most complete Anglo-Catholic ensembles.
places.descriptionIt: All Saints Margaret Street è il capolavoro neogotico policromo progettato da William Butterfield negli anni 1850. L’interno raccolto, fitto di mattoni decorati, piastrelle, marmi, soffitti dipinti e murali, forma uno dei complessi anglo-cattolici più integri del centro.
places.hookIt: La chiesa-scrigno di Butterfield avvolge i visitatori in colori vittoriani, motivi, marmi e volte dipinte.

places.name: All Hallows
places.accessNotes: Outdoor heritage site with posted opening times that can vary seasonally. Check the official site before travelling; some structures may only be viewed from the grounds.
places.hook: A Southwark pocket garden traces a Blitz-lost Gothic church through surviving arches and its former altar.
places.description: All Hallows’ Church Garden occupies the footprint of George Gilbert Scott Junior’s 1879–80 Gothic church, largely destroyed in the Blitz. Surviving arches, a chapel fragment and a cross marking the former altar make this pocket garden a compact memorial to wartime Southwark.
places.descriptionIt: Il giardino di All Hallows occupa la pianta della chiesa gotica costruita nel 1879–80 da George Gilbert Scott Junior e quasi distrutta nel Blitz. Archi superstiti, un frammento di cappella e la croce sull’antico altare raccontano la Southwark del tempo di guerra.
places.hookIt: Un piccolo giardino di Southwark ricorda una chiesa gotica perduta nel Blitz attraverso archi superstiti e l’antico altare.
places.accessNotesIt: Sito storico all’aperto con orari esposti che possono variare secondo la stagione. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire; alcune strutture possono essere osservate soltanto dall’esterno.

places.name: The Guild Church of St Katharine Cree
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: A rare pre-Civil War City church preserves Jacobean fittings and a bold classical experiment before Wren.
places.description: St Katharine Cree was rebuilt in 1628–31, making it a rare City church from the decades between the Reformation and Wren. Its classical arcades, Jacobean furnishings, rose window and association with Archbishop Laud preserve an unusual pre-Civil War religious interior.
places.descriptionIt: St Katharine Cree fu ricostruita nel 1628–31 ed è una rara chiesa della City del periodo tra Riforma e Wren. Arcate classiche, arredi giacobiani, rosone e legame con l’arcivescovo Laud conservano un insolito interno religioso precedente alla guerra civile.
places.hookIt: Una rara chiesa della City precedente alla guerra civile conserva arredi giacobiani e un audace esperimento classico prima di Wren.

places.name: French Protestant Church of London
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Britain’s last active French Huguenot church keeps four centuries of refugee history alive in Soho Square.
places.description: Built by Aston Webb in 1893, the French Protestant Church is the only active French Huguenot church in Britain. Its Flemish Gothic façade and compact Soho interior carry the story of refugees whose congregations have worshipped in London since the sixteenth century.
places.descriptionIt: Costruita da Aston Webb nel 1893, la French Protestant Church è l’unica chiesa ugonotta francese ancora attiva in Gran Bretagna. La facciata gotico-fiamminga e l’interno raccolto raccontano i rifugiati le cui comunità pregano a Londra dal Cinquecento.
places.hookIt: L’ultima chiesa ugonotta francese attiva in Gran Bretagna mantiene viva a Soho Square una storia di rifugiati lunga quattro secoli.

places.name: St Patrick's Catholic Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Behind Soho Square’s façade, ornate Catholic worship and practical outreach to vulnerable Londoners share one home.
places.description: St Patrick’s Soho Square traces its mission to 1792 and occupies a church rebuilt in 1893, with a major restoration completed in 2011. Its Italianate interior, extensive outreach to homeless and vulnerable people and long connection to Soho’s migrant communities define the parish.
places.descriptionIt: St Patrick’s Soho Square fa risalire la propria missione al 1792 e occupa una chiesa ricostruita nel 1893, restaurata profondamente nel 2011. L’interno italianeggiante, l’aiuto a persone senza dimora e il legame con le comunità migranti definiscono la parrocchia.
places.hookIt: Dietro la facciata di Soho Square convivono culto cattolico riccamente decorato e aiuto concreto ai londinesi vulnerabili.

places.name: St Margaret Pattens Church of England
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Wren’s only true medieval-style spire rises above rare canopied pews and the curious overshoes that gave the church its name.
places.description: St Margaret Pattens was rebuilt by Christopher Wren in 1687 and escaped major Blitz damage. Its slender 200-foot medieval-style spire, rare canopied churchwardens’ pews and display of pattens—the raised overshoes traditionally linked to its name—make it exceptionally characterful.
places.descriptionIt: St Margaret Pattens fu ricostruita da Christopher Wren nel 1687 e sfuggì ai gravi danni del Blitz. La sottile guglia medievaleggiante alta 200 piedi, i rari banchi coperti dei churchwardens e l’esposizione di pattens, le soprascarpe legate al nome, le danno un carattere unico.
places.hookIt: L’unica vera guglia medievaleggiante di Wren sovrasta rari banchi coperti e le curiose soprascarpe che diedero nome alla chiesa.

places.name: Tyburn Convent and Church - London
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Beside the memory of Tyburn’s gallows, an enclosed Benedictine community keeps a shrine to executed Catholic martyrs.
places.description: Tyburn Convent stands near the former Tyburn gallows and was founded in 1903 by Benedictine Adorers of the Sacred Heart. Its shrine commemorates Catholic martyrs executed nearby, while the enclosed community maintains perpetual prayer in a quiet sanctuary just beyond Marble Arch.
places.descriptionIt: Tyburn Convent sorge vicino all’antico patibolo di Tyburn e fu fondato nel 1903 dalle Benedettine Adoratrici del Sacro Cuore. Il santuario commemora i martiri cattolici giustiziati nei pressi, mentre la comunità di clausura mantiene la preghiera perpetua vicino a Marble Arch.
places.hookIt: Accanto alla memoria del patibolo di Tyburn, una comunità benedettina di clausura custodisce un santuario ai martiri cattolici giustiziati.

places.name: St John Priory Church
places.accessNotes: Public access is limited and may require a tour, appointment or attendance at a service or event. Check the official source before making a special journey.
places.hook: Beneath Clerkenwell lies the Norman crypt of the Knights Hospitaller, ancestor of today’s St John Ambulance tradition.
places.description: The Priory Church of St John preserves the twelfth-century crypt of the Knights Hospitaller’s Clerkenwell headquarters. The later church above, adjoining St John’s Gate and the museum, links medieval crusading orders with the modern Order of St John and St John Ambulance.
places.descriptionIt: La Priory Church of St John conserva la cripta del XII secolo del quartier generale dei Cavalieri Ospitalieri a Clerkenwell. La chiesa successiva, con St John’s Gate e il museo, collega gli ordini medievali al moderno Order of St John e a St John Ambulance.
places.hookIt: Sotto Clerkenwell si trova la cripta normanna dei Cavalieri Ospitalieri, antenati della tradizione odierna di St John Ambulance.
places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso pubblico è limitato e può richiedere una visita guidata, un appuntamento o la partecipazione a una funzione o a un evento. Controlla la fonte ufficiale prima di organizzare la visita.

places.name: Clapton Park United Reformed Church
places.accessNotes: Public access is limited and may require a tour, appointment or attendance at a service or event. Check the official source before making a special journey.
places.hook: Hackney’s Round Chapel turns a Victorian preaching auditorium into a dramatic community performance space.
places.description: Better known as the Round Chapel, this Grade II*-listed nonconformist landmark opened in 1871 for Clapton Park Congregational Church. Its horseshoe auditorium, cast-iron columns and surrounding galleries were designed for preaching and communal assembly and now support performances and neighbourhood events.
places.descriptionIt: Conosciuta come Round Chapel, questa architettura anticonformista di grado II* aprì nel 1871 per la Clapton Park Congregational Church. L’auditorium a ferro di cavallo, le colonne in ghisa e le gallerie furono pensati per predicazione e assemblee e oggi ospitano spettacoli ed eventi.
places.hookIt: La Round Chapel di Hackney trasforma un auditorium vittoriano per la predicazione in un suggestivo spazio comunitario per spettacoli.

places.name: Church of Saint Magnus-the-Martyr
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Stand where medieval London Bridge met the City, then find its lost houses reconstructed in miniature inside Wren’s church.
places.description: St Magnus the Martyr stands at the former head of medieval London Bridge, where its churchyard passage once channelled travellers into the City. Wren’s luminous white-and-gold interior contains a detailed bridge model, historic furnishings and memorials to the Thames and Billingsgate.
places.descriptionIt: St Magnus the Martyr sorge all’antico imbocco del London Bridge medievale, dove il passaggio del sagrato introduceva i viaggiatori nella City. Il luminoso interno bianco e oro di Wren conserva un plastico del ponte, arredi storici e memorie del Tamigi e di Billingsgate.
places.hookIt: Fermati dove il ponte medievale incontrava la City e ritrova le sue case perdute ricostruite in miniatura nella chiesa di Wren.

places.name: Southwark Cathedral
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Eight centuries of Gothic fabric connect medieval priors, Shakespeare’s Bankside and today’s Borough Market.
places.description: Southwark Cathedral grew from the Augustinian priory church of St Mary Overie, established in 1106 on a much older sacred site. Gothic fabric, the retrochoir, Shakespeare memorial, Harvard Chapel and monuments to local lives reveal the long relationship between Bankside, theatre, trade and worship.
places.descriptionIt: Southwark Cathedral deriva dalla chiesa del priorato agostiniano di St Mary Overie, fondato nel 1106 su un sito sacro più antico. Strutture gotiche, retrocoro, memoriale di Shakespeare, Harvard Chapel e monumenti locali raccontano Bankside tra teatro, commercio e culto.
places.hookIt: Otto secoli di architettura gotica collegano priori medievali, la Bankside di Shakespeare e l’odierno Borough Market.

places.name: Corpus Christi Catholic Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Behind Covent Garden’s bustle, a restored Victorian shrine glows with colour, carving and Eucharistic symbolism.
places.description: Opened in 1874, Corpus Christi Maiden Lane was conceived as a shrine to the Blessed Sacrament and is now the diocesan shrine for Westminster. Its restored Early English Gothic interior layers painted decoration, carved altars, stained glass and a sense of ritual seclusion near Covent Garden.
places.descriptionIt: Aperta nel 1874, Corpus Christi Maiden Lane fu concepita come santuario del Santissimo Sacramento ed è oggi santuario diocesano di Westminster. L’interno neogotico restaurato unisce decorazione dipinta, altari scolpiti, vetrate e raccoglimento rituale vicino a Covent Garden.
places.hookIt: Dietro il movimento di Covent Garden, un santuario vittoriano restaurato risplende di colori, sculture e simbolismo eucaristico.

places.name: St Paul's Knightsbridge
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: A restrained Knightsbridge exterior gives way to one of London’s richest Anglo-Catholic interiors and a haunting nurses’ memorial.
places.description: St Paul’s Knightsbridge opened in 1843 and became a formative church of the Victorian Anglo-Catholic revival. Its richly coloured interior, rood screen, sculpture and memorials—including an acclaimed memorial to First World War nurse Fanny—contrast sharply with the restrained brick exterior.
places.descriptionIt: St Paul’s Knightsbridge aprì nel 1843 e divenne un luogo fondamentale della rinascita anglo-cattolica vittoriana. L’interno ricco di colore, il tramezzo, le sculture e i monumenti, compreso quello alla nurse Fanny della Prima guerra mondiale, contrastano con l’esterno sobrio.
places.hookIt: Un esterno sobrio a Knightsbridge introduce a uno dei più ricchi interni anglo-cattolici di Londra e a un toccante monumento alle infermiere.

places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: A quiet Wren church has become a treasury of carved woodwork rescued from vanished City churches.
places.description: St Margaret Lothbury was rebuilt by Christopher Wren and completed in 1692, with a tower by Robert Hooke. Its restrained City exterior hides exceptional seventeenth-century woodwork rescued from demolished churches, including a reredos, font, communion rails and screen associated with Grinling Gibbons.
places.descriptionIt: St Margaret Lothbury fu ricostruita da Christopher Wren e completata nel 1692, con torre di Robert Hooke. L’esterno sobrio nasconde straordinari legni seicenteschi salvati da chiese demolite, tra cui pala, fonte, balaustra e transenna associati a Grinling Gibbons.
places.hookIt: Una tranquilla chiesa di Wren è diventata un tesoro di legni scolpiti salvati da chiese scomparse della City.

places.name: St Bride's Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Wren’s wedding-cake spire rises above a crypt of Roman remains and a church devoted to Fleet Street’s press.
places.description: St Bride’s is the journalists’ church of Fleet Street, rebuilt by Christopher Wren after the Great Fire and again after the Blitz. Its tiered wedding-cake spire, Roman and medieval crypt remains, printing memorials and superb acoustic connect sacred architecture with London’s press history.
places.descriptionIt: St Bride’s è la chiesa dei giornalisti di Fleet Street, ricostruita da Christopher Wren dopo il Grande Incendio e ancora dopo il Blitz. La guglia a piani simile a una torta nuziale, i resti romani e medievali della cripta e i memoriali della stampa legano architettura e giornalismo.
places.hookIt: La guglia a torta nuziale di Wren sovrasta una cripta con resti romani e una chiesa dedicata alla stampa di Fleet Street.

places.hook: A Victorian church near Knightsbridge has been transformed by icons and liturgy into London’s Russian Orthodox cathedral.
places.description: The Russian Orthodox Cathedral of the Dormition occupies a church built in 1849 and adapted for Orthodox worship after 1956. Its iconostasis, icons and incense-filled liturgy transform an Italianate Victorian building into the cathedral of the Diocese of Sourozh.
places.descriptionIt: La cattedrale russo-ortodossa della Dormizione occupa una chiesa del 1849, adattata al culto ortodosso dopo il 1956. Iconostasi, icone e liturgia avvolta dall’incenso trasformano l’edificio vittoriano italianeggiante nella cattedrale della diocesi di Sourozh.
places.hookIt: Una chiesa vittoriana vicino a Knightsbridge è stata trasformata da icone e liturgia nella cattedrale russo-ortodossa di Londra.

places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Kensington’s skyline is pierced by George Gilbert Scott’s 278-foot spire above a richly vaulted parish church.
places.description: George Gilbert Scott rebuilt St Mary Abbots in 1872 in an exceptionally tall Early English Gothic style. Its 278-foot spire dominates Kensington, while the vaulted interior, stained glass, monuments and surviving medieval features preserve the memory of earlier churches on the site.
places.descriptionIt: George Gilbert Scott ricostruì St Mary Abbots nel 1872 in un altissimo stile gotico Early English. La guglia di 278 piedi domina Kensington, mentre interno voltato, vetrate, monumenti e resti medievali conservano la memoria delle chiese precedenti.
places.hookIt: Lo skyline di Kensington è trafitto dalla guglia di 278 piedi di George Gilbert Scott sopra una ricca chiesa voltata.

places.name: Bloomsbury Central Baptist Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: A pioneering 1848 Baptist landmark pairs a theatrical twin-towered façade with a tradition of social action.
places.description: Bloomsbury Central Baptist Church opened in 1848, financed and built by the Baptist contractor and railway entrepreneur Samuel Morton Peto. Its imposing twin-towered façade shelters a broad preaching interior, long associated with progressive ministry, social action and public debate in the West End.
places.descriptionIt: La Bloomsbury Central Baptist Church aprì nel 1848, finanziata e costruita dall’imprenditore battista Samuel Morton Peto. La monumentale facciata a due torri introduce a un’ampia sala di predicazione, legata da tempo a ministero progressista, impegno sociale e dibattito pubblico.
places.hookIt: Un pionieristico edificio battista del 1848 unisce una scenografica facciata a due torri a una tradizione di impegno sociale.

places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Pepys lies beneath a medieval survivor whose skull-topped gate gave Dickens the name ‘St Ghastly Grim.’
places.description: St Olave Hart Street is a rare medieval City church that escaped the Great Fire. Its low nave, Tudor monuments and crypt carry associations with Samuel Pepys, who worshipped here and is buried beside his wife, while the skull-crowned churchyard gate inspired Dickens.
places.descriptionIt: St Olave Hart Street è una rara chiesa medievale della City sfuggita al Grande Incendio. La bassa navata, i monumenti Tudor e la cripta ricordano Samuel Pepys, qui sepolto con la moglie, mentre il portale del sagrato coronato da teschi ispirò Dickens.
places.hookIt: Pepys riposa in una chiesa medievale il cui portale coronato da teschi spinse Dickens a chiamarla “St Ghastly Grim”.

places.name: St. Etheldreda's RC Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: A narrow passage in Holborn leads to the thirteenth-century chapel and undercroft of the medieval bishops of Ely.
places.description: St Etheldreda’s is the surviving chapel of the medieval bishops of Ely, built in the late thirteenth century. Its undercroft, stone vaulting and stained glass make it one of London’s oldest Catholic churches and a rare intact fragment of a great medieval town palace.
places.descriptionIt: St Etheldreda’s è la cappella superstite del palazzo medievale dei vescovi di Ely, costruita alla fine del XIII secolo. Cripta, volte in pietra e vetrate ne fanno una delle più antiche chiese cattoliche di Londra e un raro frammento integro di palazzo medievale.
places.hookIt: Uno stretto passaggio a Holborn conduce alla cappella duecentesca e alla cripta dei vescovi medievali di Ely.

places.name: St Marylebone Parish Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: A Regency portico and cupola shelter a parish history entwined with Dickens, Browning and medical Marylebone.
places.description: Thomas Hardwick completed the present St Marylebone Parish Church in 1817 with a Corinthian portico and a graceful cupola. Its crypt, historic organ, stained glass and associations with figures from Charles Dickens to Elizabeth Barrett Browning reflect the changing life of Marylebone.
places.descriptionIt: Thomas Hardwick completò l’attuale St Marylebone Parish Church nel 1817 con portico corinzio e aggraziata cupola. Cripta, organo storico, vetrate e legami con figure da Charles Dickens a Elizabeth Barrett Browning riflettono la vita mutevole di Marylebone.
places.hookIt: Un portico Regency e una cupola custodiscono una storia parrocchiale intrecciata con Dickens, Browning e la Marylebone medica.

places.name: IMPRINT Church London: St Mary Woolnoth
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Hawksmoor compressed monumental Baroque drama into a small square church perched above Bank station.
places.description: St Mary Woolnoth is Nicholas Hawksmoor’s compact City masterpiece, completed in 1727 with a boldly rusticated façade and paired towers. The powerful square interior, clustered columns and Baroque geometry survive directly above Bank station, now shared by an active congregation.
places.descriptionIt: St Mary Woolnoth è il compatto capolavoro della City progettato da Nicholas Hawksmoor e completato nel 1727, con facciata bugnata e torri gemelle. Il vigoroso interno quadrato, le colonne raggruppate e la geometria barocca sopravvivono sopra la stazione Bank.
places.hookIt: Hawksmoor concentrò il dramma barocco monumentale in una piccola chiesa quadrata sospesa sopra la stazione Bank.

places.name: St Margaret's Church
places.accessNotes: Visitor admission, worship access and opening times differ. Check the official site for the day’s schedule, tickets, closures and any areas reserved for services.
places.hook: The parish church of Parliament preserves Tudor glass and political memory in Westminster Abbey’s shadow.
places.description: St Margaret’s Westminster has served the House of Commons as its parish church since the seventeenth century. Rebuilt in the late fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries, it holds brilliant stained glass, parliamentary memorials and the graves of figures including Walter Raleigh beside Westminster Abbey.
places.descriptionIt: St Margaret’s Westminster è la chiesa parrocchiale della Camera dei Comuni dal Seicento. Ricostruita tra fine Quattrocento e inizio Cinquecento, conserva splendide vetrate, memorie parlamentari e tombe di figure come Walter Raleigh accanto a Westminster Abbey.
places.hookIt: La chiesa parrocchiale del Parlamento conserva vetrate Tudor e memoria politica all’ombra di Westminster Abbey.
places.accessNotesIt: Ingresso turistico, accesso al culto e orari sono distinti. Controlla il sito ufficiale per programma giornaliero, biglietti, chiusure e aree riservate alle funzioni.

places.name: St. Benet Welsh Church Paul's Wharf
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Wren’s best-preserved original City interior has carried Welsh-language Anglican worship since Victorian times.
places.description: St Benet Paul’s Wharf was rebuilt by Wren in 1683 and is his only City church to retain its original internal arrangement substantially intact. Since 1879 it has served London’s Welsh-speaking Anglican community, pairing a compact Baroque interior with regular worship in Welsh.
places.descriptionIt: St Benet Paul’s Wharf fu ricostruita da Wren nel 1683 ed è l’unica sua chiesa della City a conservare sostanzialmente l’assetto interno originale. Dal 1879 serve la comunità anglicana gallese di Londra, unendo un raccolto interno barocco al culto in lingua gallese.
places.hookIt: L’interno originale di Wren meglio conservato nella City ospita culto anglicano in gallese dall’epoca vittoriana.

places.name: St Bartholomew the Great
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Pass beneath a Tudor gatehouse into London’s most complete Norman church and the shadowed tomb of its founder.
places.description: Founded in 1123 by Rahere, St Bartholomew the Great preserves the most substantial Norman church interior in central London. Massive round arches, the medieval choir, Rahere’s tomb and the timber-framed gatehouse make entry from Smithfield feel like a passage into another city.
places.descriptionIt: Fondata nel 1123 da Rahere, St Bartholomew the Great conserva il più importante interno ecclesiastico normanno del centro di Londra. Massicci archi a tutto sesto, coro medievale, tomba di Rahere e portale a graticcio trasformano l’ingresso da Smithfield in un passaggio verso un’altra città.
places.hookIt: Attraversa un portale Tudor ed entra nella chiesa normanna più completa di Londra, accanto alla tomba in ombra del fondatore.

places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Blore’s Victorian parish church gained an Arts and Crafts face while keeping deep roots in working Chelsea.
places.description: Christ Church Chelsea was built in 1839 to designs by Edward Blore for a rapidly growing riverside district. Its later Arts and Crafts west front by W. D. Caröe and strong tradition of local service make it both an architectural layer-cake and a record of nineteenth-century social Chelsea.
places.descriptionIt: Christ Church Chelsea fu costruita nel 1839 da Edward Blore per un quartiere fluviale in rapida crescita. La successiva facciata Arts and Crafts di W. D. Caröe e la tradizione di servizio locale ne fanno un palinsesto architettonico e sociale della Chelsea ottocentesca.
places.hookIt: La chiesa vittoriana di Blore acquistò un volto Arts and Crafts mantenendo profonde radici nella Chelsea popolare.

places.name: Willesden Jewish Cemetery (United Synagogue)
places.accessNotes: Cemetery grounds have daily gate times that can vary seasonally. Check the official site for current hours, tours and any restrictions on photography or access to chapels and catacombs.
places.hook: The House of Life opens a major Victorian Jewish cemetery through the stories of families who shaped modern Britain.
places.description: Opened in 1873, Willesden Jewish Cemetery is a Grade II-listed landscape and the resting place of many leading figures in British Jewish history. Its funerary architecture, mature grounds and House of Life visitor experience interpret traditions of mourning alongside stories of science, commerce, art and public service.
places.descriptionIt: Aperto nel 1873, il cimitero ebraico di Willesden è un paesaggio di grado II e luogo di sepoltura di molte figure della storia ebraica britannica. Architettura funeraria, parco maturo e percorso House of Life raccontano lutto, scienza, commercio, arte e servizio pubblico.
places.hookIt: La House of Life apre un grande cimitero ebraico vittoriano attraverso le storie di famiglie che contribuirono alla Gran Bretagna moderna.
places.accessNotesIt: Il cimitero ha orari di apertura dei cancelli che possono variare secondo la stagione. Controlla il sito ufficiale per orari aggiornati, visite guidate e limitazioni a fotografie, cappelle o catacombe.

places.name: Lesnes Abbey Lodge
places.accessNotes: Outdoor heritage site with posted opening times that can vary seasonally. Check the official site before travelling; some structures may only be viewed from the grounds.
places.hook: Medieval abbey foundations meet ancient woodland at a site tied to the aftermath of Thomas Becket’s murder.
places.description: Lesnes Abbey was founded in 1178 by Richard de Luci, traditionally as penance for his part in the events leading to Thomas Becket’s murder. The excavated Augustinian ruins sit beside ancient woodland, with interpretation revealing the church, cloister, chapter house and monastic infirmary.
places.descriptionIt: Lesnes Abbey fu fondata nel 1178 da Richard de Luci, secondo la tradizione come penitenza per il suo ruolo negli eventi che portarono all’uccisione di Thomas Becket. Le rovine agostiniane sorgono accanto a un bosco antico e mostrano chiesa, chiostro e infermeria.
places.hookIt: Le fondazioni di un’abbazia medievale incontrano un bosco antico in un luogo legato alle conseguenze dell’uccisione di Thomas Becket.
places.accessNotesIt: Sito storico all’aperto con orari esposti che possono variare secondo la stagione. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire; alcune strutture possono essere osservate soltanto dall’esterno.

places.name: St Anne's Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Soho’s rebuilt parish church gathers three centuries of immigrant, theatrical and musical lives around its surviving tower.
places.description: St Anne’s was consecrated in 1686 for the new parish of Soho and became closely entwined with the district’s immigrant, theatrical and musical life. The Blitz left only its distinctive 1803 tower, around which the present church and garden were rebuilt and reopened in 1991.
places.descriptionIt: St Anne’s fu consacrata nel 1686 per la nuova parrocchia di Soho e si legò profondamente alla vita immigrata, teatrale e musicale del quartiere. Il Blitz lasciò soltanto la caratteristica torre del 1803, attorno alla quale chiesa e giardino furono ricostruiti e riaperti nel 1991.
places.hookIt: La chiesa parrocchiale ricostruita di Soho raccoglie tre secoli di vite immigrate, teatrali e musicali attorno alla torre superstite.

places.name: St Augustine’s Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Kilburn’s ‘Cathedral of North London’ is a soaring Victorian Gothic world of brick vaults, screens and ritual.
places.description: John Loughborough Pearson designed St Augustine’s Kilburn from 1870 as a monumental Anglo-Catholic church, later nicknamed the Cathedral of North London. Its soaring brick vaults, long nave, chapels, screens and stained glass create one of the capital’s most powerful Victorian Gothic interiors.
places.descriptionIt: John Loughborough Pearson progettò St Augustine’s Kilburn dal 1870 come monumentale chiesa anglo-cattolica, poi soprannominata Cattedrale del Nord di Londra. Volte in mattoni, lunga navata, cappelle, transenne e vetrate creano uno dei più potenti interni gotici vittoriani della capitale.
places.hookIt: La “Cattedrale del Nord di Londra” a Kilburn è un mondo gotico vittoriano di volte in mattoni, transenne e ritualità.

places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Blue roofs and gilded onion domes announce a purpose-built Orthodox cathedral beside the Thames at Chiswick.
places.description: The Russian Orthodox Cathedral of the Nativity of the Mother of God and Holy Royal Martyrs was purpose-built in Chiswick from the late 1990s. White walls, blue roofs, gilded domes, icons and a traditional interior create a distinct Orthodox landmark beside the Thames.
places.descriptionIt: La cattedrale russo-ortodossa della Natività della Madre di Dio e dei Santi Martiri Imperiali fu costruita appositamente a Chiswick dalla fine degli anni Novanta. Pareti bianche, tetti azzurri, cupole dorate, icone e interni tradizionali ne fanno un riferimento ortodosso sul Tamigi.
places.hookIt: Tetti azzurri e cupole a cipolla dorate annunciano una cattedrale ortodossa costruita appositamente sul Tamigi a Chiswick.

places.name: St George's Cathedral
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Pugin’s bomb-damaged cathedral was reborn in the 1950s as a striking dialogue between Gothic survival and post-war renewal.
places.description: A. W. N. Pugin’s St George’s opened in 1848 and became the Roman Catholic cathedral for Southwark. Badly damaged in 1941, it was rebuilt by Romilly Craze in 1958, blending surviving Gothic elements, post-war design and a continuing role at the centre of Catholic South London.
places.descriptionIt: La St George’s di A. W. N. Pugin aprì nel 1848 e divenne la cattedrale cattolica di Southwark. Gravemente danneggiata nel 1941, fu ricostruita da Romilly Craze nel 1958, fondendo elementi gotici superstiti, design del dopoguerra e vita cattolica contemporanea.
places.hookIt: La cattedrale bombardata di Pugin rinacque negli anni Cinquanta in un dialogo tra sopravvivenza gotica e rinnovamento del dopoguerra.
places.accessNotesIt: Luogo di culto attivo. L’accesso dei visitatori può variare durante funzioni, cerimonie ed eventi comunitari; controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire e mantieni un comportamento rispettoso durante il culto.

places.name: St Mary-le-Bow Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: The sound of Bow Bells defines a Cockney, beneath one of Wren’s most elegant City steeples.
places.description: St Mary-le-Bow was rebuilt by Christopher Wren after the Great Fire and crowned with one of his most accomplished steeples. The bells define the traditional soundscape of Cockney identity, while the crypt, post-Blitz interior and Australian memorial chapel deepen the church’s global City story.
places.descriptionIt: St Mary-le-Bow fu ricostruita da Christopher Wren dopo il Grande Incendio e coronata da uno dei suoi campanili più riusciti. Le campane definiscono l’identità cockney, mentre cripta, interno ricostruito dopo il Blitz e cappella australiana ampliano la storia internazionale della chiesa.
places.hookIt: Il suono delle Bow Bells definisce un vero cockney sotto uno dei più eleganti campanili della City progettati da Wren.

places.name: St Stephen Walbrook
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Wren’s rehearsal for St Paul’s dome now centres on a radical circular altar carved by Henry Moore.
places.description: Christopher Wren rebuilt St Stephen Walbrook in the 1670s and used its pioneering dome as a testing ground before St Paul’s Cathedral. Twelve Corinthian columns create a luminous centralised interior, now focused on Henry Moore’s circular stone altar and the church’s Samaritans legacy.
places.descriptionIt: Christopher Wren ricostruì St Stephen Walbrook negli anni 1670 e usò la cupola innovativa come prova prima di St Paul’s Cathedral. Dodici colonne corinzie formano un luminoso interno centrale, oggi segnato dall’altare circolare di Henry Moore e dall’eredità dei Samaritans.
places.hookIt: La prova di Wren per la cupola di St Paul’s ruota oggi attorno al radicale altare circolare scolpito da Henry Moore.

places.name: St Christopher's Chapel
places.accessNotes: Public access is limited and may require a tour, appointment or attendance at a service or event. Check the official source before making a special journey.
places.hook: This ornate hospital chapel survived redevelopment by being wrapped in steel and moved whole along rails.
places.description: Edward Middleton Barry designed St Christopher’s Chapel for Great Ormond Street Hospital in 1875. When the surrounding building was replaced in the 1980s, the richly decorated Italianate chapel was encased, moved on rails and restored, preserving a beloved sanctuary for patients, families and staff.
places.descriptionIt: Edward Middleton Barry progettò la St Christopher’s Chapel per il Great Ormond Street Hospital nel 1875. Negli anni Ottanta la ricca cappella italianeggiante fu ingabbiata, spostata su rotaie e restaurata, conservando un luogo molto amato da pazienti, famiglie e personale.
places.hookIt: Questa cappella ospedaliera decorata sopravvisse alla ricostruzione grazie a una gabbia d’acciaio e a uno spostamento intero su rotaie.
places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso pubblico è limitato e può richiedere una visita guidata, un appuntamento o la partecipazione a una funzione o a un evento. Controlla la fonte ufficiale prima di organizzare la visita.

places.name: St Mary Abchurch
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: A plain City exterior opens into Wren’s intimate painted dome and one of Grinling Gibbons’s richest reredoses.
places.description: St Mary Abchurch was rebuilt after the Great Fire by Christopher Wren and completed in 1686. Its plain brick exterior conceals a luminous domed ceiling painted by William Snow, a carved Grinling Gibbons reredos and an intimate, almost theatrical Baroque interior.
places.descriptionIt: St Mary Abchurch fu ricostruita dopo il Grande Incendio da Christopher Wren e completata nel 1686. Il semplice esterno in mattoni nasconde una cupola luminosa dipinta da William Snow, una pala di Grinling Gibbons e un intimo interno barocco quasi teatrale.
places.hookIt: Un semplice esterno della City si apre sulla cupola dipinta di Wren e su una delle più ricche pale di Grinling Gibbons.

places.name: St James the Less Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Striped brickwork and a free-standing Italianate tower make G. E. Street’s Pimlico church instantly distinctive.
places.description: G. E. Street designed St James the Less in 1858–61 as a robust, polychromatic Gothic church for Pimlico. Red brick, striped stone, a detached Italianate campanile and a richly articulated interior make this Grade I-listed building an influential statement of Victorian ecclesiastical design.
places.descriptionIt: G. E. Street progettò St James the Less nel 1858–61 come vigorosa chiesa gotica policroma per Pimlico. Mattoni rossi, fasce di pietra, campanile italianeggiante separato e un interno riccamente articolato ne fanno un’opera vittoriana influente di grado I.
places.hookIt: Mattoni a fasce e un campanile italianeggiante isolato rendono immediatamente riconoscibile la chiesa di G. E. Street a Pimlico.

places.hook: Traditional Saiva architecture and festival ritual make this Lewisham temple a focal point of Tamil London.
places.description: Lewisham Sivan Temple developed from London’s Tamil Saiva community and was reconstructed according to traditional Agamic principles. Its colourful shrines centre on Shiva while festivals, ritual music and teaching sustain a major South London hub for Tamil Hindu worship and culture.
places.descriptionIt: Il Lewisham Sivan Temple nasce dalla comunità tamil saiva di Londra ed è stato ricostruito secondo i principi tradizionali degli Agama. I santuari colorati dedicati a Shiva, le feste, la musica rituale e l’insegnamento ne fanno un importante centro hindu tamil.
places.hookIt: Architettura saiva tradizionale e rituali festivi rendono questo tempio di Lewisham un punto di riferimento della Londra tamil.

places.name: St George's Church
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Hawksmoor crowned his last London church with George I, lions and unicorns on a wildly theatrical stepped spire.
places.description: Completed in 1730, St George’s Bloomsbury was Nicholas Hawksmoor’s final London church. Its portico faces the British Museum quarter while the extraordinary stepped steeple—topped by George I and guarded by lions and unicorns—turns ancient Mausoleum imagery into exuberant English Baroque.
places.descriptionIt: Completata nel 1730, St George’s Bloomsbury fu l’ultima chiesa londinese di Nicholas Hawksmoor. Il portico guarda verso il British Museum, mentre l’insolito campanile a gradoni, coronato da Giorgio I e sorvegliato da leoni e unicorni, trasforma l’antico Mausoleo in Barocco inglese.
places.hookIt: Hawksmoor coronò la sua ultima chiesa londinese con Giorgio I, leoni e unicorni su una teatrale guglia a gradoni.

places.hook: A warm-brick Victorian church anchors the leafy, lens-shaped garden square of The Boltons.
places.description: St Mary The Boltons was designed by George Godwin and completed in 1850 at the centre of an elegant garden square. Its twin roofs, warm brick, stained glass and intimate scale make it a characteristic Victorian parish church embedded in the planned landscape of west Chelsea.
places.descriptionIt: St Mary The Boltons fu progettata da George Godwin e completata nel 1850 al centro di un elegante giardino residenziale. Tetti gemelli, mattoni caldi, vetrate e scala intima ne fanno una tipica chiesa parrocchiale vittoriana inserita nel paesaggio pianificato di Chelsea ovest.
places.hookIt: Una chiesa vittoriana in mattoni caldi occupa il cuore del verde giardino lenticolare dei Boltons.

places.hook: A medieval hospital chapel hides an elegant octagonal Georgian interior inside the working Barts precinct.
places.description: St Bartholomew the Less began as the chapel of St Bartholomew’s Hospital and remains embedded within its historic precinct. A medieval tower opens into an unusual octagonal Georgian interior remodelled by George Dance the Younger, linking centuries of worship with Britain’s oldest working hospital.
places.descriptionIt: St Bartholomew the Less nacque come cappella dell’ospedale di St Bartholomew ed è ancora inserita nel suo recinto storico. Una torre medievale introduce a un insolito interno georgiano ottagonale rinnovato da George Dance il Giovane, unendo culto e storia ospedaliera.
places.hookIt: Una cappella ospedaliera medievale nasconde un elegante interno georgiano ottagonale nel complesso ancora attivo di Barts.

places.hook: A crisp 1960s chapel beside Exhibition Road combines worship with a public visitors’ and family-history centre.
places.description: The Hyde Park Chapel of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints opened in 1961 as a modernist landmark by T. P. Bennett and Son. Alongside worship spaces, a visitors’ centre and family-history facilities introduce Latter-day Saint belief and genealogy near Exhibition Road.

places.name: Tower Hamlets Cemetery Park
places.accessNotes: Cemetery grounds have daily gate times that can vary seasonally. Check the official site for current hours, tours and any restrictions on photography or access to chapels and catacombs.
places.hook: East End social history and genuine urban woodland have grown together across a former Victorian cemetery.
places.description: Opened in 1841 as one of the Magnificent Seven, Tower Hamlets Cemetery closed to burials and became London’s first urban woodland nature reserve. War memorials, ivy-covered graves, mature trees and local volunteers now make it both a record of East End communities and a rich wildlife habitat.
places.descriptionIt: Aperto nel 1841 come uno dei Magnificent Seven, Tower Hamlets Cemetery fu chiuso alle sepolture e divenne la prima riserva naturale boscosa urbana di Londra. Monumenti di guerra, tombe coperte d’edera, alberi maturi e volontari raccontano le comunità dell’East End e la biodiversità.
places.hookIt: Storia sociale dell’East End e vero bosco urbano sono cresciuti insieme in un ex cimitero vittoriano.

places.hook: Hand-carved stone shipped from India turns a Wembley street into an exuberant modern Hindu landmark.
places.description: Shri Sanatan Hindu Mandir opened in 2010 after artisans in India carved its limestone and marble components using traditional methods. The richly ornamented Wembley temple brings multiple deities, carved pillars, domes and narrative sculpture together in a major modern expression of Sanatan Hindu practice.
places.descriptionIt: Lo Shri Sanatan Hindu Mandir aprì nel 2010 dopo che artigiani in India avevano scolpito a mano i suoi elementi in calcare e marmo. Il ricco tempio di Wembley riunisce molte divinità, pilastri, cupole e sculture narrative in una grande espressione moderna della tradizione Sanatan.
places.hookIt: Pietra scolpita a mano in India trasforma una strada di Wembley in un esuberante riferimento hindu moderno.

places.hook: Neasden’s marble mandir turns hand-carved stone and timber into one of London’s great modern sacred interiors.
places.description: Completed in 1995, BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir was assembled from thousands of pieces of hand-carved Italian marble and Bulgarian limestone without structural steel. The adjoining haveli adds intricately carved timberwork, while exhibitions explain Hindu belief, craft and community life.
places.descriptionIt: Completato nel 1995, il BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir fu assemblato senza acciaio strutturale con migliaia di blocchi di marmo italiano e calcare bulgaro scolpiti a mano. L’haveli affianca intagli lignei e mostre sulla fede, l’artigianato e la comunità hindu.
places.hookIt: Il mandir di Neasden trasforma pietra e legno intagliati a mano in uno dei grandi interni sacri moderni di Londra.

places.hook: A serene Georgian church at the old City gate hides an unexpectedly rich Victorian chancel and carved angels.
places.description: The present St Botolph without Aldgate was completed in 1744 by George Dance the Elder on a medieval site just outside the City wall. Its calm Georgian proportions contain notable monuments, a richly remodelled Victorian chancel and carved angels associated with C. F. A. Voysey.
places.descriptionIt: L’attuale St Botolph without Aldgate fu completata nel 1744 da George Dance il Vecchio su un sito medievale appena fuori dalle mura. Le sobrie proporzioni georgiane racchiudono monumenti, un presbiterio vittoriano e angeli scolpiti associati a C. F. A. Voysey.
places.hookIt: Una serena chiesa georgiana presso l’antica porta cittadina nasconde un presbiterio vittoriano e angeli scolpiti.

places.name: London Oratory
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: A vast Italianate nave, marble chapels and celebrated music bring Roman Baroque grandeur to South Kensington.
places.description: The London Oratory was completed in 1884 to Herbert Gribble’s grand Italian Baroque design and remains home to the Oratorian community. Its immense nave, dome, marble chapels, sculpture and renowned choral tradition offer a Roman scale and ceremony opposite the Victoria and Albert Museum.
places.descriptionIt: Il London Oratory fu completato nel 1884 nel grandioso stile barocco italiano di Herbert Gribble ed è tuttora sede degli oratoriani. Immensa navata, cupola, cappelle marmoree, sculture e celebre musica corale portano scala e solennità romane davanti al Victoria and Albert Museum.
places.hookIt: Una vasta navata all’italiana, cappelle marmoree e musica celebre portano la grandiosità barocca romana a South Kensington.

places.hook: This modest Hornsey Rise church is best understood through the food, family and community work happening inside.
places.description: St Mary’s Hornsey Rise is a community-focused Anglican church serving the Andover Estate and surrounding streets. The present building and its active hall support worship, food and family programmes, making the site valuable less as a monument than as a working piece of neighbourhood infrastructure.
places.descriptionIt: St Mary’s Hornsey Rise è una chiesa anglicana fortemente comunitaria al servizio dell’Andover Estate e delle strade vicine. L’edificio e la sala sostengono culto, iniziative alimentari e attività per famiglie, come infrastruttura viva del quartiere più che come monumento.
places.hookIt: Questa semplice chiesa di Hornsey Rise si comprende soprattutto attraverso le attività alimentari, familiari e comunitarie che ospita.

places.hook: A broad Georgian preaching house occupies the ground of Clerkenwell’s lost medieval nunnery.
places.description: St James Clerkenwell stands on the site of a twelfth-century Benedictine nunnery. James Carr’s 1792 preaching church retains broad galleries and a spacious interior, while the surrounding churchyard and nearby medieval gate place it within Clerkenwell’s remarkable monastic and civic landscape.
places.descriptionIt: St James Clerkenwell sorge sul sito di un monastero benedettino femminile del XII secolo. La chiesa di predicazione costruita da James Carr nel 1792 conserva ampie gallerie, mentre il sagrato e la vicina porta medievale la inseriscono nel paesaggio monastico e civile di Clerkenwell.
places.hookIt: Un’ampia chiesa georgiana per la predicazione occupa il terreno dell’antico monastero femminile di Clerkenwell.

places.hook: A Greek necropolis, Gothic monuments and hidden catacombs make West Norwood one of London’s richest cemetery landscapes.
places.description: West Norwood opened in 1837 as the South Metropolitan Cemetery and is one of London’s Magnificent Seven. Its Greek Orthodox necropolis, Gothic monuments, catacombs and graves of scientists, artists and reformers survive within a dramatic landscape that also contains a modern crematorium.
places.descriptionIt: West Norwood aprì nel 1837 come South Metropolitan Cemetery ed è uno dei Magnificent Seven. Necropoli greco-ortodossa, monumenti gotici, catacombe e tombe di scienziati, artisti e riformatori sopravvivono in un paesaggio suggestivo con crematorio moderno.
places.hookIt: Una necropoli greca, monumenti gotici e catacombe nascoste fanno di West Norwood uno dei paesaggi cimiteriali più ricchi di Londra.

places.hook: A former Swedenborgian church became a living archive of Polish faith, exile and wartime London.
places.description: This Devonia Road church began as a nineteenth-century Swedenborgian building and became the Polish Catholic parish of Our Lady of Częstochowa and St Casimir in 1930. Its art, memorials and Adam Bunsch stained glass record the faith and wartime experience of London’s Polish diaspora.
places.descriptionIt: Questa chiesa di Devonia Road nacque nell’Ottocento per gli Swedenborgiani e nel 1930 divenne la parrocchia cattolica polacca di Nostra Signora di Częstochowa e San Casimiro. Arte, memorie e vetrate di Adam Bunsch raccontano fede ed esperienza bellica della diaspora polacca.
places.hookIt: Un’ex chiesa swedenborgiana è diventata un archivio vivo di fede polacca, esilio e Londra in guerra.

places.hook: A Tudor riverside church keeps the elusive burial story of royal astrologer and polymath John Dee.
places.description: St Mary the Virgin, Mortlake has medieval origins but was substantially rebuilt in 1543 and later enlarged. Its riverside parish history includes Tudor brickwork, monuments to local families and the burial of Elizabeth I’s astrologer John Dee somewhere within the church or churchyard.
places.descriptionIt: St Mary the Virgin a Mortlake ha origini medievali, ma fu in gran parte ricostruita nel 1543 e poi ampliata. La sua storia fluviale comprende muratura Tudor, monumenti di famiglie locali e la sepoltura dell’astrologo di Elisabetta I, John Dee, nella chiesa o nel sagrato.
places.hookIt: Una chiesa Tudor sul fiume custodisce l’elusiva storia della sepoltura dell’astrologo reale e poliedrico John Dee.

places.name: Fulham Road Jewish Cemetery
places.accessNotes: Public access is limited and may require a tour, appointment or attendance at a service or event. Check the official source before making a special journey.
places.hook: An easily missed Chelsea wall encloses the first Jewish burial ground established west of the City.
places.description: Established in 1815 by the Western Synagogue, Fulham Road Jewish Cemetery was the first Jewish burial ground west of the City. Its compact walled plot preserves Georgian and Victorian Hebrew memorials, including graves linked to notable Anglo-Jewish families, behind an easily missed entrance.
places.descriptionIt: Fondato nel 1815 dalla Western Synagogue, il cimitero ebraico di Fulham Road fu il primo luogo di sepoltura ebraico a ovest della City. Il piccolo recinto conserva lapidi georgiane e vittoriane in ebraico e tombe di importanti famiglie anglo-ebraiche.
places.hookIt: Un muro facile da ignorare a Chelsea racchiude il primo cimitero ebraico fondato a ovest della City.
places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso pubblico è limitato e può richiedere una visita guidata, un appuntamento o la partecipazione a una funzione o a un evento. Controlla la fonte ufficiale prima di organizzare la visita.

places.name: Golders Green Crematorium
places.accessNotes: Cemetery grounds have daily gate times that can vary seasonally. Check the official site for current hours, tours and any restrictions on photography or access to chapels and catacombs.
places.hook: London’s first crematorium unfolds through quiet colonnades and one of the capital’s finest memorial gardens.
places.description: Opened in 1902 as London’s first crematorium, Golders Green combines Ernest George’s red-brick and stone buildings with formal Grade I-listed memorial gardens. Colonnades, chapels, ponds and monuments commemorate figures from Sigmund Freud to Marc Bolan across a remarkably serene landscape.
places.descriptionIt: Aperto nel 1902 come primo crematorio di Londra, Golders Green unisce gli edifici in mattoni e pietra di Ernest George a giardini commemorativi formali di grado I. Colonnati, cappelle, stagni e monumenti ricordano personalità da Sigmund Freud a Marc Bolan.
places.hookIt: Il primo crematorio di Londra si sviluppa tra colonnati silenziosi e uno dei più raffinati giardini commemorativi della capitale.
places.accessNotesIt: Il cimitero ha orari di apertura dei cancelli che possono variare secondo la stagione. Controlla il sito ufficiale per orari aggiornati, visite guidate e limitazioni a fotografie, cappelle o catacombe.

places.name: Our Lady of Victories
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: A post-war church by Adrian Gilbert Scott carries forward the memory of Kensington’s bombed Victorian pro-cathedral.
places.description: Our Lady of Victories succeeded a grand 1869 pro-cathedral that was destroyed by wartime bombing. Adrian Gilbert Scott’s replacement opened in 1959, giving Kensington a spacious modern Catholic church whose restrained exterior leads to a warm, high-volume interior.
places.descriptionIt: Our Lady of Victories sostituisce la grande pro-cattedrale del 1869 distrutta dai bombardamenti. La nuova chiesa di Adrian Gilbert Scott aprì nel 1959 e offre a Kensington un ampio spazio cattolico moderno, sobrio all’esterno e caldo, slanciato all’interno.
places.hookIt: Una chiesa del dopoguerra di Adrian Gilbert Scott porta avanti la memoria della pro-cattedrale vittoriana bombardata di Kensington.
places.accessNotesIt: Luogo di culto attivo. L’accesso dei visitatori può variare durante funzioni, cerimonie ed eventi comunitari; controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire e mantieni un comportamento rispettoso durante il culto.

places.name: St Mary Aldermary
places.accessNotes: Active place of worship. Visitor access may change around services, ceremonies and community events; check the official site before travelling and behave respectfully during worship.
places.hook: Gothic fan vaults—not classical Baroque—make this one of the most surprising churches rebuilt after the Great Fire.
places.description: Rebuilt after the Great Fire and attributed to Wren’s office, St Mary Aldermary is an unusual City church in late Gothic rather than classical dress. Its spectacular fan-vaulted plaster ceiling, clustered columns and chequered history now frame the welcoming Host Café and Moot community.
places.descriptionIt: Ricostruita dopo il Grande Incendio e attribuita allo studio di Wren, St Mary Aldermary è un’insolita chiesa della City in veste tardo-gotica anziché classica. Lo spettacolare soffitto a ventaglio, le colonne e la storia stratificata oggi accolgono Host Café e la comunità Moot.
places.hookIt: Volte gotiche a ventaglio, non Barocco classico, fanno di questa una delle chiese più sorprendenti ricostruite dopo il Grande Incendio.

places.name: Paddington Old Cemetery - Michael Bond
places.accessNotes: Cemetery grounds have daily gate times that can vary seasonally. Check the official site for current hours, tours and any restrictions on photography or access to chapels and catacombs.
places.hook: Victorian avenues lead to Michael Bond’s grave and a final, affectionate nod to Paddington Bear.
places.description: Paddington Old Cemetery opened in 1855 with a distinctive horseshoe plan, paired chapels and mature avenues. Among its varied monuments is the grave of Paddington Bear creator Michael Bond, whose headstone carries a tender reference to the bear he gave the world.
places.descriptionIt: Paddington Old Cemetery aprì nel 1855 con una caratteristica pianta a ferro di cavallo, cappelle gemelle e viali alberati. Tra i molti monumenti si trova la tomba di Michael Bond, creatore di Paddington Bear, con un affettuoso richiamo all’orso.
places.hookIt: I viali vittoriani conducono alla tomba di Michael Bond e a un ultimo, affettuoso richiamo a Paddington Bear.

places.name: National Trust - Fenton House and Garden
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.hook: Early keyboards fill a seventeenth-century merchant’s house above a walled Hampstead orchard.
places.description: Fenton House is a late-seventeenth-century merchant’s house on Hampstead’s highest ground, acquired for the National Trust with the collection of Major Benton Fletcher. Panelled rooms contain early keyboard instruments, porcelain and needlework, while a walled garden preserves orchard, kitchen beds and formal planting.
places.descriptionIt: Fenton House è una casa mercantile del tardo Seicento sul punto più alto di Hampstead, acquisita dal National Trust con la collezione del maggiore Benton Fletcher. Sale rivestite in legno ospitano antichi strumenti a tastiera, porcellane e ricami; il giardino murato conserva frutteto, orto e aiuole formali.
places.hookIt: Antichi strumenti a tastiera riempiono una casa mercantile seicentesca sopra un frutteto murato di Hampstead.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.

places.name: Harrow School Chapel
places.accessNotes: This is primarily a working or private building and is best appreciated from the public realm. Interior access is limited to authorised visits or occasional open days.
places.hook: Scott’s flint-and-stone chapel gives Harrow’s hilltop campus its emphatic Victorian Gothic landmark.
places.description: George Gilbert Scott designed Harrow School Chapel, completed in 1855, in a muscular Gothic Revival style suited to its hilltop setting. Flint and stone, a prominent bell turret, stained glass and memorial fittings make it both the school’s place of worship and a record of generations of pupils.
places.descriptionIt: George Gilbert Scott progettò la cappella della Harrow School, completata nel 1855, in un deciso stile neogotico adatto alla posizione sulla collina. Selce e pietra, torre campanaria, vetrate e monumenti la rendono luogo di culto e memoria di generazioni di studenti.
places.hookIt: La cappella in selce e pietra di Scott dà al campus collinare di Harrow il suo deciso punto di riferimento neogotico.
places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.

places.name: Severndroog Castle
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.hook: A triangular Georgian memorial tower turns a naval victory into one of south-east London’s best viewpoints.
places.description: Architect Richard Jupp built Severndroog Castle in 1784 for Lady James as a memorial to her husband, Commodore Sir William James, whose naval victory at Suvarnadurg inspired its name. The triangular Gothic tower crowns Shooter’s Hill; restored rooms and a roof platform give long views across London and Kent.
places.descriptionIt: L’architetto Richard Jupp costruì Severndroog Castle nel 1784 per Lady James in memoria del marito, il commodoro Sir William James, la cui vittoria navale a Suvarnadurg ispirò il nome. La torre gotica triangolare corona Shooter’s Hill; sale restaurate e terrazza offrono ampie vedute su Londra e Kent.
places.hookIt: Una torre commemorativa georgiana triangolare trasforma una vittoria navale in uno dei migliori belvedere del sud-est di Londra.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.

places.hook: Embassy roots and Spanish royal links animate one of central London’s grandest late-Victorian Catholic interiors.
places.description: St James’s Spanish Place grew from the chapel of the Spanish Embassy and opened in its present form in 1890. Edward Goldie’s lofty English Gothic interior includes a hammerbeam roof, carved chapels and Spanish royal associations, sustaining one of London’s most distinctive Catholic parishes.
places.descriptionIt: St James’s Spanish Place deriva dalla cappella dell’ambasciata spagnola e aprì nella forma attuale nel 1890. L’alto interno gotico inglese di Edward Goldie comprende tetto a capriate lignee, cappelle scolpite e legami con la monarchia spagnola.
places.hookIt: Origini diplomatiche e legami con la monarchia spagnola animano uno dei più grandiosi interni cattolici tardo-vittoriani del centro.

Its landmark spire, carved stone, stained glass and fittings associated with the Pugin circle reflect the confidence of London’s revived nineteenth-century Catholic community.

places.hookIt: Una guglia sottile e dettagli dell’epoca di Pugin segnano la sicura rinascita cattolica ottocentesca di Greenwich.

places.hook: A former burial ground has become a richly planted green room behind Mayfair’s Mount Street.
places.description: Mount Street Gardens opened as a public garden in 1889 on the former burial ground of St George’s Hanover Square. Plane trees, exotic planting, ornate benches and the Gothic Church of the Immaculate Conception create a secluded green room behind Mayfair’s commercial streets.
